title: Print your counter poster
summary: Print once and keep it up for good. People scan it and see whatever you're running.

steps.title: Open Posters
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Posters. On a computer, it's in the menu on the left.

steps.title: Choose the line on your poster
steps.body: Your poster says "Scan to get your Tikka" with your QR code. You can use the everyday line, which never goes out of date, or show your current reward.

steps.title: Print it
steps.body:
Tap "Print your poster" and choose a size: an A4 window poster, an A5 counter standee, a table tent or a 5 cm sticker. Save it as a PDF and print it, or take it to a printer.

Put it where people wait or pay: your counter, door, mirror or tables.

steps.title: Add more spots
steps.body: Tap "Add a poster for another spot" for each extra place. Each poster gets its own code, so you can see which spot brings people in.

tips: When there's no drop running, the poster opens your business page, so it never leads nowhere.
